title: BanStereoSet: A Dataset to Measure Stereotypical Social Biases in LLMs for Bangla
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures stereotypical social biases related to religion by presenting a fill-in-the-blank sentence and asking the model to choose from a stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, or unrelated option. For example, associating 'Muslims' with being 'bold'.
findings: Across all tested models, both in Bangla and English, the level of stereotypical bias related to religion was found to be relatively low compared to other bias categories like profession, gender, or beauty.
references: Josh Achiam, Steven Adler, Sandhini Agarwal, Lama Ahmad, Ilge Akkaya, Florencia Leoni Aleman, Diogo Almeida, Janko Altenschmidt, Sam Altman, Shyamal Anadkat, et al. 2023. Gpt-4 technical report. arXiv preprint arXiv:2303.08774.
